subject: Order Form: finalize pricing slices, net terms, and invoice routing
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@medivex.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@medivex.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Forward: Draft Order Form questions (pricing slices + invoicing)

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for sending the draft earlier. Finance reviewed and we have a couple of items that would block procurement sign-off unless clarified on the order form:

1) Pricing slices: the banding shows yearly minimums but the procurement team needs the monthly cadence for invoicing trigger and to align with their fiscal close. Can you confirm whether we can convert the annual minimum-commit ladder into monthly invoice triggers (e.g., trigger at 1/12th of the annual band) or if Redwood requires annual invoicing?

2) Net terms: Medivex typically operates on Net 45. The order form lists Net 30 by default — is Net 45 negotiable for the enterprise entity? If Net 45 is acceptable, we need a billing contact and a PO acceptance workflow documented in the order form.

3) Tax/withholding: country of residence for the billing entity is US, but they asked whether Redwood will gross up for any withholding or if Medivex is responsible. They want a short clause in the order form on tax responsibility.

We attached the procurement checklist. Can your legal/finance team confirm changes and, if acceptable, return a redlined order form? We are aiming to sign by next Friday.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

— Lydia
Medivex, Procurement

Attachment: Medivex_Procurement_Checklist_20260527.pdf
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@medivex.com>, Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@medivex.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forward: Draft Order Form questions (pricing slices + invoicing)

Lydia — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below so procurement can keep to the target sign date: 

- Pricing cadence: we can support monthly invoice triggers tied to a monthly minimum threshold (1/12th of the committed annual band) but need an explicit invoice acceptance flow documented in the order form (to avoid disputes on monthly consumption smoothing). I attached an example pricing schedule that maps annual bands to monthly triggers.

- Net terms: we can offer Net 45 for enterprise contracts with a slight commercial adjustment (we typically keep Net 30 for smaller accounts). If Medivex needs Net 45, we will reflect Net 45 on the order form and require a billing PO/AR contact (name, email) and an initial ACH/wire instruction confirmation before first invoice.

- Tax/withholding: Redwood does not gross up by default. The customer is responsible for any local withholding unless a gross-up is negotiated. We can add a short clause: "Customer is responsible for all taxes and any withholding obligations; where applicable, Redwood may invoice for amounts grossed up if previously agreed in writing."

Next steps: 
1) I have asked Finance & Legal to add redlines to the attached order form (Medivex_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf).
2) Kim — can you review the proposed Net 45 path and the short tax clause; also confirm whether we should include a PO-attachment appendix for monthly triggers?
3) Ben — can you prepare the DocuSign envelope and confirm whether pricing modification requires CSM sign-off or if Sales can finalize?

If helpful, I'm available for a 20-min call this afternoon.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0197

Attachments: pricing_bands_20260528.xlsx (mapping of annual bands to monthly triggers), Medivex_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf (draft with placeholders)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lydia Park <lydia.park@medivex.com>, Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@medivex.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 14:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forward: Draft Order Form questions (pricing slices + invoicing)

Naomi / Ben / Medivex team —

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the redline and here are the legal/finance comments we will include in the updated order form: 

1) Monthly invoice triggers: acceptable as proposed, but we need an explicit definition of "monthly invoiced minimum" in the order form: language inserted under Section 2 (Fees & Payment) will state the calculation and the reconciliation process at year-end. This avoids double-billing if consumption fluctuates mid-year.

2) Net terms alignment: we can accept Net 45. To mitigate credit exposure we will require either (a) an advance deposit equal to the first month’s invoiced minimum, or (b) credit approval documentation from Medivex AR. Please indicate preferred option.

3) Taxes and withholding: proposed clause is fine. Add a second sentence to clarify: "If Customer is required by law to withhold taxes from payments to Redwood, Customer will provide evidence of such withholding and pay any gross-up amounts within thirty (30) days of notification by Redwood."

4) PO and invoice routing: include a PO acceptance appendix that lists the Medivex billing contact and required PO format. We will add a short checkbox in the order form that confirms whether invoices should be routed to the AR mailbox or to a designated finance system.

5) Attachments: please attach the pricing_bands_20260528.xlsx as Exhibit A. Also note that any pricing true-up disputes will be escalated to Solutions Engineering then to Legal in 15 business days per the dispute timeline.

I will circulate a clean redlined PDF and a Word copy for Medivex to redline. For sales process: once Medivex confirms PO routing and whether they prefer an advance deposit or credit approval, Sales can finalize the commercial terms and I will sign off on the legal language.

Kimberly Park
Lead, Contracts & Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0112

Attachments: Medivex_OrderForm_v3_redline_legal.pdf (legal comments), ExhibitA_pricing_bands.xlsx

All — quick note from Sales side: we can proceed with Net 45 and monthly invoice triggers as long as Medivex confirms PO routing and either (i) advance deposit for month 1 or (ii) credit approval by 2026-06-04. I will prepare the DocuSign envelope once Medivex confirms which credit mitigation they prefer.

If Medivex wants a short call to confirm the mechanics, I'm available Monday 10–11am PT. Otherwise, if we receive the PO contact and selection (deposit vs credit approval) in writing today/tomorrow, I'll put the envelope together and loop in CS for onboarding timing.

— Ben
Director, Commercials | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

Subject: Re: Forward: Draft Order Form questions (pricing slices + invoicing)

Lydia / Oliver —

Thanks — Kim and Ben have confirmed our position and next steps. To summarize and keep the sign schedule tight: 

1) We will issue a Word redline (Medivex_OrderForm_v3_redline_legal.pdf and Word copy) reflecting: monthly invoice trigger language, Net 45, the short tax clause with gross-up mechanics, and a PO appendix.
2) Please confirm whether Medivex will provide an advance deposit equal to month one invoiced minimum OR provide credit approval paperwork by 2026-06-04. Either option is acceptable to Redwood.
3) Once confirmed we will generate a DocuSign envelope and circulate for signatures (target EOD 2026-06-08).

If you prefer to sign faster and want the deposit route, let us know and Ben will send a payment link. If you prefer to pursue credit approval, please attach the AR contact and any required forms.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call Monday if helpful — Ben suggested Monday 10–11am PT.

Regards,
Naomi
